card.title: 84th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 84th Infantry Regiment was attached to the 6th Rifle Division of the Red Army in WWII. In the opening stages of Operation Barbarossa the division was stationed in Brest in Belarus and took part in the defense of the Brest Fortress, which later became a symbol of Soviet resistance. The 6th Rifle Division took part in many military operations during WWII, including the Third Battle of Kharkov, the Battle of the Korsun Cherkassy Pocket, the Soviet invasion of Manchuria. The division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner twice and the Order of Suvorov 2nd Class for its valor in combat.
